digest.overview: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 launch dominates the window, claiming near-Fable 5 performance with stronger safeguards and standout scores like 30.2% on ARC-AGI 3. Parallel policy pushback from Nvidia, Meta, and Microsoft against open-weight restrictions highlights U.S.-China AI tensions, while Midjourney and Cognition acquisitions show product diversification.

top_story.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5, close to Fable 5 capabilities
top_story.summary: Opus 5 posts 30.2% on ARC-AGI 3, claims perfect IMO score and second place on SimpleBench (1% behind Fable). Cheaper and less restrictive than Fable per Anthropic, with classifiers intervening 85% less often.
top_story.why_it_matters: Positions Anthropic as direct Fable rival via faster iteration and scaled RL; early tester notes it matches Fable on short tasks but lags on ambitious long ones.

sentiment.label: bullish
sentiment.summary: Community excited by Opus 5 benchmarks and iteration speed vs Fable; open-weight lobbying adds policy tension but model news drives optimism.

model_releases.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5
model_releases.summary: New flagship model nears Fable 5 performance at lower cost with fewer restrictions.

frontier_labs.headline: Nvidia, Meta, Microsoft urge against broad open-weight restrictions
frontier_labs.summary: 20+ firms sign letter warning policymakers on premature curbs amid Chinese AI and distillation concerns.

frontier_labs.headline: Cognition acquires Poke for AI personality edge
frontier_labs.summary: Deal values Poke in low nine figures; adds conversational style to Devin coding agent.

influencer_takes.author: Ethan Mollick
influencer_takes.quote: In my testing, Opus 5 replaced Opus 4.8 for me, it was generally stronger in everything... except it shares some of the weird language quirks of Fable.
influencer_takes.context: Early access tester highlights strengths and Fable-like quirks on creative tasks.

influencer_takes.author: Nathan Lambert
influencer_takes.quote: Insane numbers for opus 5, the power of faster iteration speed + scaled RL (Fable too big to RL as well, yet).
influencer_takes.context: Notes safeguards improvement and RL scaling advantage over larger rivals.

influencer_takes.author: Ethan Mollick
influencer_takes.quote: I had access to Opus 5 before release and found it to be a good model if a quirky one. On shorter tasks, it could match or beat Fable levels of performance, at longer tasks it seemed less ambitious.
influencer_takes.context: Contrasts short vs long task performance pre-release.

research_radar.headline: Team uses AlphaFold to redesign gene-editing proteins for safety
research_radar.summary: Google's AlphaFold identifies mistake-prone parts of editing proteins.

research_radar.headline: [Paper] Statistically-Lossless Quantization of Large Language Models
research_radar.summary: Addresses compression-fidelity tradeoffs beyond GPTQ/AWQ or purely lossless methods.

post_ideas.hook: Opus 5 just matched Fable on short tasks but skipped the long ambitious ones
post_ideas.draft: Early testers say Opus 5 beats or ties Fable on quick work yet delivers less complete results on extended agentic tasks. The RL iteration edge is real, but ambition gap persists.
post_ideas.why_viral: Highlights concrete performance nuance in the new model race right after launch.

post_ideas.hook: 20+ firms including Nvidia and Meta just told regulators: hands off open weights
post_ideas.draft: Nvidia, Meta, Microsoft and others signed today's open letter against premature open-weight bans, explicitly separating distillation from theft. Policy fight heating up.
post_ideas.why_viral: Direct industry pushback on U.S. China AI response creates clear sides and stakes.

post_ideas.hook: Midjourney just bought an astrology app
post_ideas.draft: Midjourney acquires Co-Star, the personalized astrology app, after moving from cat pics to ultrasound scans. AI labs keep expanding into unexpected verticals.
post_ideas.why_viral: Surprising acquisition signals broader AI product ambitions beyond core generation.
